entries.claim: The reference-integrity defect class (dead current links, scripts pointing at removed paths) is currently EMPTY in this repository.
entries.evidence: 315 tracked markdown files scanned on origin/main: 0 broken relative markdown links. 48 backticked repository paths do not resolve, but every hit was triaged: external models.dev catalog identities (EXECUTION_PROVIDER_OVERRIDE.md:38 providers/opencode-go/models/space-bunny-free.toml), historical WORKSTREAM_STATE.yaml provenance records naming their own original worktree paths, or deliberately quoted nonexistent files describing a defect (GOVERNANCE_SUPERSESSION.md:34). A separate scan of 612 workflow/script files produced 143 hits, all of which are runtime output paths (artifacts/...) created by the workflow, not stale input references. A link checker was therefore considered and REJECTED under the reuse-first gate: it would add a maintenance surface to guard a class with zero live defects, and an AGENTS.md section-number guard would create a new CI failure coupled to open PR #261's in-flight AGENTS.md edits.
